name: Principality of New Antioch
source: Warbands of Trench Crusade 1.0.2; Prussian Stosstruppen Warband booklet (Feb 2026); New Antioch Prussian Stosstruppen / Prussian Yeomen / Sniper Priests kit guides (Oct 2026, no rules); The Red Brigade v1.5; Carcass Front Errata

specialRules.name: New Antioch Fireteams
specialRules.text: Up to 2 Fireteams of any two models each (FIRETEAM Keyword, free). Concentrated Attack: if a Fireteam model hits a target already hit earlier in the same joint Activation by its partner, spend 3 BLOOD MARKERS to turn the second Injury Roll into a Bloodbath Roll even if the target is not Down.

abilities.name: Hold Your Fire! ACTION
abilities.text: Pick 1 enemy model in Line of Sight that the opponent may Activate; the Lieutenant's Activation ends and the opponent must Activate that model next.

abilities.name: Absolute Faith
abilities.text: The opponent cannot spend BLOOD MARKERS to add -DICE to this model's Ranged Attacks.

abilities.name: Aim ACTION
abilities.text: Risky Success Roll with +2 DICE (failure ends the Activation). On a success, +2 DICE to its Ranged Attack Success Rolls for the rest of the Activation.

abilities.name: God is With Us! ACTION
abilities.text: Risky Success Roll (failure ends the Activation). On a success place 1 BLESSING MARKER beside the Cleric or a friendly model within 6".

abilities.name: Onward Christian Soldiers!
abilities.text: Friendly NEW ANTIOCH models within 8" have NEGATE FEAR.

models.name: Yeoman
models.kitRule: any; may take its Bolt-Action Rifle for 5 ducats instead of 10

upgrades.name: Trench Mole
upgrades.text: Gains INFILTRATOR. Up to 2 per Warband (a 3rd if all other models cost 1,000 ducats or more).

abilities.name: Assault Drill
abilities.text: Ignores the HEAVY effect for 1 Melee Weapon it carries; still limited to 1 HEAVY weapon.

abilities.name: Shock Charge
abilities.text: Roll one extra D6 for its Charge Bonus and use the single highest die.

models.name: Combat Engineer
models.kitRule: any except Armour (armour already in profile)

abilities.name: Battlefield Demolition
abilities.text: Ignores the HEAVY effect of 1 Satchel Charge; still limited to 1 HEAVY weapon.

abilities.name: Set Mine ACTION
abilities.text: In contact with a terrain piece up to 8"x8" without MINED: Success Roll with +2 DICE; on a success the piece gains MINED.

abilities.name: Defuse Mine
abilities.text: On touching a MINED marker/terrain it may try to defuse: Risky Success Roll; failure detonates it and ends the Activation, success removes MINED. Mines it set itself are defused automatically.

abilities.name: Fortify ACTION
abilities.text: Risky Success Roll (failure ends the Activation); on a success it has COVER until it moves away.

models.name: Mechanized Heavy Infantry

upgrades.name: Machine Armour
upgrades.text: Swap the fixed Reinforced Armour for Machine Armour (total 95): Armour -3, Bulky (D3" Charge Bonus, no Trench Shield) and Standfast.

abilities.name: Expert Medic
abilities.text: +2 DICE to the Risky Success Roll when it uses a Medi-kit for a Treat ACTION.

abilities.name: Finish the Fallen

sim.cond: target is Down, not BLACK GRAIL/DEMONIC

uniqueKit.name: Engineer Body Armour
uniqueKit.text: Ballistic Box Armour: attacks with SHRAPNEL against the wearer get -1 INJURY DICE, even if they have IGNORE ARMOUR.

uniqueKit.name: Heavy Ballistic Shield
uniqueKit.text: Only for models wearing Machine Armour; Shield Combo. The bearer always counts as in cover.

uniqueKit.name: Machine Armour
uniqueKit.text: Bulky: base becomes 40mm (if smaller), no Trench Shield, Charge Bonus D3" instead of D6". Standfast: a Down result on the Injury table counts as a Minor Hit instead.

variants.name: Éire Rangers

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Tactics

variants.name: Stosstruppen of the Free State of Prussia
variants.changes: Book variant (Warbands 1.0.2) cross-checked against the Feb 2026 'Prussian Stosstruppen Warband' booklet, which restates the same variant as a full list with Prussian names (Hauptmann = Lieutenant, Feldkaplan = Trench Cleric, Stosstruppen = Shock Troopers); the Oct 2026 Prussian Stosstruppen / Prussian Yeomen / Sniper Priests PDFs are model assembly guides with no rules changes. Variant: 2-8 Shock Troopers (no Assault Drill), up to 3 Fireteams, +4" grenade range, Rapid Assault (+5) for Hauptmann and Stosstruppen, up to 2 Stosstruppen INFILTRATOR (+10), max 1 Sniper Priest and 1 MHI, no Trench Moles, no Grenade Launchers or Martyrdom Pills, SMG Limit 4, Automatic Pistols lose ELITE only, Machine Gun Limit 1, only Hauptmann and MHI may wear Reinforced/Machine Armour; adds Tank-Splitter Sword and Holy Smoke. Conflict: the Feb 2026 booklet lists Sniper Rifle Limit 2, the newer book 1.0.2 (Sept 2026) keeps Limit 3, so Limit 3 is used.

variants.name: The Red Brigade

specialRules.text: May include Trench Dogs of the Red Brigade, never more than the other models. A dog's first two Glorious Deeds each battle earn 2 Glory instead of 1.

lists.name: The Iron Wall of the Seventy-Seven Towers
lists.style: Gunline: two Machine-Gun walkers, twin blind Sniper Priests and a rifle picket hold the line while the Communicant's anti-materiel rifle cracks armour; the Cleric keeps them steady.

models.label: Sister Lucia of the Black Scapular

lists.name: Moles of No Man's Land
lists.style: Infiltration assault: three Trench Moles pop up forward, Combat Engineers lob Satchel Charges into strongpoints and Shock Troopers with greatswords and SMGs pair up as Fireteams for Bloodbath kills; the Witchburner marks targets.

lists.name: The Fianna of Connacht
lists.style: Guerrilla raiders: infiltrating, skirmishing Fianna with claymores lead a Berserker Lieutenant into the flank while two warrior-priests heal and knock enemies flat, and an anointed-round sniper picks off officers.

models.label: Lt. Niamh O'Rourke, the Red Hound

lists.name: Claymores of Dùn Èideann
lists.style: All-in Highland charge: STRONG Shock Troopers with cheap claymores and shield-polearms, a Lochaber-axe Lieutenant and a Machine-Armoured walker that keeps its full charge, piped forward fearless by the bagpipes.

lists.name: The 6th Gardekorps of Königsberg
lists.style: Blitz assault: five Stosstruppen with Rapid Assault and long-range grenades, three as SMG Fireteam gunners (two infiltrating), chained with a Tank-Splitter Hauptmann and Feldkaplan on Holy Smoke; a single Sniper Priest covers the approach.

lists.name: Chewa of the Solomonic Throne
lists.style: Half-moon envelopment: Flanking Yeomen hit from the table edges with short-range fire while Chewa Shock Troopers gang up in melee; two Holy Warriors and two Medics with Lalibela water keep everyone standing, the Tabot turning every heal into blessings.

lists.name: Blood Pledges of Saint Ernest
lists.style: Suicidal deep strike: a two-pistol Gunslinger Lieutenant with his attack dog, SMG troopers and a Crimson Communicant who grows stronger as the starting Blood Markers pile on; dogs ferry Molotovs and drag the fallen, and nobody ever retreats.
